subject: If you want make to build in parallel by default (for ./runTests.py) set MAKEFLAGS

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: If you want make to build in parallel by default (for ./runTests.py) set MAKEFLAGS
parts:
It's in the RStan doc and it works from the command line.

Add this to make/local:

MAKEFLAGS = -j2




Daniel

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: If you want make to build in parallel by default (for ./runTests.py) set MAKEFLAGS
parts:
Actually... it doesn't work using runTests.py. That sets the flag manually.

Mitzi, think we should change this behavior? I guess I'm thinking for runTests.py:
- if '-j#' is provided from the command line, pass that to make.
- if not, then don't pass '-j1' to the command line. currently, if no '-j' argument is passed to runTests.py, it automatically sends '-j1' to the call to make.


Daniel

MAKEFLAGS = -j2
